title: CarsSearch per-request favorites
description: Schema for Requests/<request_id>/favorites.json — a user-curated shortlist referencing model ids from that same request's results.json. Favorites are per-request: the viewer keys its localStorage as 'carResearchFavorites:<request_id>', and the 'Export favorites.json' button produces a file in exactly this shape to commit back.

favorite_ids.description: Model `id` values from this request's results.json. No duplicates.
